phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless communication radio module, designed for real-time soil moisture measurement and remote data transmission in agricultural environments.

This integrated design is widely adopted due to ease of deployment and accurate soil moisture sensing with wireless data transmission capabilities.
